messages:
Jessica M: FYI customer requested the full artifact set for their security review (SIG/CAIQ follow-up). Need pen test + external vuln scan exports + remediation timeline by EOD Thu. Any blockers?

Mike L: Uploading consolidated bundle to the secure share now. Will post signed URLs when done. ETA ~30m. :thumbsup:

Aleks K: Heads up — we need to redact internal IPs and any PII from screenshots before sending. I can run a scrub script. Who owns the raw scan exports?

Mike L: I do. file is scan-export-2026-03.tar.gz in our internal artifacts bucket. Will hand to you. Command to fetch: 
``
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-internal/artifacts/scan-export-2026-03.tar.gz ./ && tar -xzf scan-export-2026-03.tar.gz
```

Security Bot: Upload complete. Bundle: s3://redwood-secure-share/customer-acme/1905000000-evidence-bundle.tar.gz  Expires in 7 days.

Samir R: For remediation timeline: commit to critical fixes (CVSS >= 9) within 5 business days, high in 10 business days, medium depends but target 30 business days. Need triage list from eng and owner assignment. :white_check_mark:

Rachael S: Can someone map the findings to SIG controls? Customer specifically asked for CAIQ mapping too. I can do it but need the vulnerability IDs + test cases in CSV format.

Aleks K: I'll produce a sanitized artifacts folder + findings.csv with columns: vuln_id, severity, cvss, evidence_path, remediation_owner, suggested_eta. Will also include remediation_ticket column linking to internal tracker.

Mike L: Sharing signed URLs (short-lived): https://redwood-secure-shares.example/1905000000-evidence-bundle.tar.gz?sig=REDACTED (expires in 7d)

Jessica M: I will post to the customer's secure portal and email their security contact to confirm delivery. Copying Legal for NDA mention. Anyone object? :eyes:

Samir R: No objections. Please ensure each remediation item has an internal ticket and SLA assigned. Also include an owner for critical items.

Mike L: Added remediation_ticket links to findings.csv and included a README in the bundle describing redactions, contact points, and how to request deeper logs.

Rachael S: I started the CAIQ mapping locally. ETA to finish and upload mapping.csv: tomorrow 12:00 PM PT. I'll flag any control gaps that require product/security input.

Jessica M: Great, thanks. I'll send an interim note to the customer confirming deliverables + expected remediation SLAs and include the signed URL + findings.csv. Will close thread once sent. :rocket:

Security Bot: Audit-log created for this transfer. audit_id=AZ-3882, retention=90d.
